notes: ἐάνπερ is an ordinary conditional and is aligned to *if*; rule 72 is not in question, no relative or indefinite standing before it.
ὁ before θεός is `unrepresented` under rule 23, the ASV writing no determiner.
ποιήσομεν → *will we do* heads on *do* under rule 9 despite the English inversion.
